notes.title: PROZE is TIGA awards finalist
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33360089/d24d60580c842df0d8b6af8ca77a3f20578d39a4.png[/img]
🏆🏆 We're incredibly proud to announce PROZE: Enlightenment has been shortlisted for the Best Action and Adventure Game and for the Best Visual Design TIGA awards!

It is a pleasure to see among finalists our nationals Frogwares with their game The Sinking City, a few games from our favorite studio's Ninja Theory, PlayStation London Studio and other amazing games.

🎮 The 2019 TIGA Games Industry Awards will be held on Thursday 7th November at the iconic Natural History Museum, London.

✔️ The shortlist is live here: https://tiga.org/awards/2019-shortlist

✔️ Vote for PROZE for the #Gameoftheyear here: https://tiga.org/awards/game-of-the-year

Thanks to all the Judges. Have a great day!

notes.title: PROZE is a Finalist for VR Game of the Year!

PROZE: Enlightenment for being officially made a Finalist - VR Game of the Year for the VR Awards 2019. This is an incredible achievement against considerable competition.

notes.title: PROZE: Enlightenment needs two more weeks
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33360089/239b95bff0ad4d0b88f574a87e27c81587535917.png[/img]
SignSine is a tiny indie studio tackling an ambitious Unreal Engine powered VR project. So we're constantly trying to beat the odds and deliver a quality game with our small resources. And now we’ve suffered another setback (the final one) – we’re missing the promised April 11 release date. The bright side – only just a little. We need two more weeks to finish PROZE: Enlightenment and you’ll be able to play the game on April 25.

Thanks for your understanding! Now back to work.

notes.notes:

PROZE is a VR survival adventure. Set in both past and present, it’s a story of friendship and duty, fear, and dignity of the people facing the Soviet government and its echoes. Explore a Cold-War era military research facility, deal with the anomalies, solve the puzzles, and find out the answers.

notes.title: The final update is out!
PROZE: Episode I release date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
First of all, a huge thanks to everyone who played and continues to play PROZE: Prologue! Your comments and reviews have helped to make it a much better experience.

Also, the original release date for the first full episode of PROZE was set for November. However, we’ve considered our work on the Prologue chapter and decided that we want to bring you a truly immersive VR experience – adding more detailed visuals and animations, new gameplay mechanics, additional localizations, and an expanded narrative with an epic ending. So we need a little more time for that.

PROZE Episode I: Enlightenment now releases in February 2019.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/924250/PROZE_Episode_I_Enlightenment/
Stay tuned!
